items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: this Culbertson guy was with me, he told them, he said, 'Well, I know a guy'

ctx.x: Those guys got through with me that afternoon. They hung me. So I even hurt my hand, you know, while I was out there. So in the meantime, next day, some fellows were trying to find somebody to play for a school party. Couldn't find nobody around there nowhere. So this Culbertson guy was with me, he told them, he said, "Well, I know a guy -- I don't know how many songs he knows, but I know he knows a couple of songs." They said, "Man, we want anybody. We don't care who it is. Just get anybody. If they don't know…

So he sent them up there to me, you know. So I said, "No, fellas, I couldn't play that." They said, "Do you know any songs at all?" I said, "I know about one or two songs." They said, "Well, you come on and you play them one or two songs all night, long as the party lasts, and we'll pay you." I said, "What?" They said, "We'll pay you." I said, "Okay."
